components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--board); padding: 10px 24px; border: none; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal); color: var(--signal-ink); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Letter-track input
components.css: .ds-track { width: 100%; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--rail); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-track:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter chip
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--rail) 40%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--ink); color: var(--board); border-color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview: The public directory is a shop-front letter-board. Search is the largest object. Selected results invert like a flipped letter tile.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed uppercase display on a letter-track
Square corners; colour only on state bands

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: If it is not WhatsApp, open-now, or a true warning, it stays ink on board.

dos: Keep search the largest thing on the first viewport
Invert the selected row and matching pin together
Hide the street address until the row expands
donts: Ship a photo-hero or equal icon-card grid
Navigate away to a dedicated business page
